name: debate-mode
description: Evidence-first debate. Researches a claim or proposal and returns a sourced verdict (Yes / No / Partly / Not enough evidence) before recommending anything. Use when the user asks to debate, argue, push back or fact-check ("debat pakai fakta", "jangan iya-iya aja", "don't just agree", "prove it"), or wants a sourced verdict on a claim or on a change to a statement or CV. Not for ordinary questions.
